groupSwap.text: About 4.7% of the time, a tier-3 slot is replaced by a fixed group of smaller monsters. Groups are never mixed.

rules: Each monster in a tier is equally likely to be picked. Tier counts are rolled per map load.
Monsters get a grace period of about 4–5 minutes after spawning. After that, a monster that is far (20+ units) from every player despawns in 20–40 seconds. Being near it pauses that timer.
Killing a monster roughly triples its respawn time. Gnomes and Bangers seem to be exempt.
Loud things (instruments, gunfire, explosions, animal crates) shave about 5 seconds off respawn timers per noise.
The longer you stay in a level, the faster monsters come back. Don't linger once the quota is done.
At most 10 monster orbs can lie on the map (the oldest explodes). Each monster drops at most 3 orbs per session. Gnomes and Bangers drop none.
When final extraction starts, monsters converge on the truck, so have your exit route clear.
notes: Spawn table and respawn timers come from community datamining and testing (Fantime Horror, Haplo's Substack). Older guides give slightly different grace periods.
